title: $\zeta_0$: A Framework for World Action Models with Joint Scene and Body Foresight in Humanoid Control
abstract: arXiv:2611.29277v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: World Action Models anticipate visual outcomes to guide robot actions, yet humanoid interaction also depends on how the robot's body responds. Visual foresight alone can miss body motion, while latent-distance losses do not directly supervise action responses. We present $\zeta_0$, a framework that turns vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by foreseeing future visual features and measured joint trajectories in a shared latent representation. During training, a teacher conditioned on recorded futures provides a reference action response, and dual-response transfer trains the causal predictor to match it through the teacher and the executing policy. All components are trained jointly, and deployment uses only causally predicted futures. translated_title: ζ₀：一个在人形机器人控制中实现场景与身体联合预判的世界动作模型框架
translated_abstract: 世界动作模型通过预测视觉结果来指导机器人动作，然而人形机器人的交互还依赖于机器人自身身体如何响应。仅依靠视觉预判可能遗漏身体运动，而潜在距离损失又无法直接监督动作响应。我们提出了ζ₀，一个通过在共享潜在表示中同时预测未来视觉特征和测量的关节轨迹，将视觉-语言-动作策略转化为世界动作模型的框架。在训练过程中，以记录的未来状态为条件的教师模型提供参考动作响应，双重响应迁移则通过教师模型和执行策略来训练因果预测器以匹配该响应。所有组件联合训练，部署时仅使用因果预测的未来状态。在七个HumanoidArena任务上，基于Ψ₀和GR00T N1.7构建的ζ₀分别达到63.6%和79.5%的平均成功率，比这些基线高出18.8和9.0个百分点。在六个真实世界任务上，它达到……
tldr: ζ₀框架通过在共享潜在表示中同时预测未来视觉特征与关节轨迹，将视觉-语言-动作策略升级为兼具场景与身体预判能力的世界动作模型，在人形机器人仿真与真实任务上均显著超越基线性能。
en_tdlr: ζ₀ upgrades vision-language-action policies into World Action Models by jointly foreseeing future visual features and joint trajectories in a shared latent representation, substantially outperforming baselines on both simulated and real-world humanoid control tasks.
